a.lede: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking competition.
a.title: Elon Musk intensifies attack on Ambani over Starlink India launch delay

b.lede: “Is Ambani the real boss of India?” Elon Musk asked as he questioned why Starlink has yet to launch its satellite internet service in the country.
b.title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls
